q1_issues.issue: The inner 'One can say' event carries no subject role at all — generic 'one' is dropped rather than given a witness (an antecedent-less human pronoun is classed person), leaving a saying with no sayer.
'at the moment' (a deictic present time) is dropped; a copular clause with a time modifier reifies the state to anchor the Time atom, keeping the flat form beside it.

(Member sk_level_1 level), the typing of the definite 'the level', is kept inside the seal although a definite referent inside a seal projects to top level — as sk_euro_1 and sk_fundamentals_1 do in this same parse.

'is at the level' uses the entity-attached (At sk_euro_1 sk_level_1), but 'at' is one of the containment prepositions the instruction routes to LocatedIn, with the surface head reserved for the other prepositions.

q2_gaps: generic / impersonal 'one' as a subject — it is neither a bare plural nor an explicit quantifier, and the antecedent-less-pronoun list (he/she/they/it) does not cover it
an approximator hedging a non-numeric predicate ('is about at the level') — ParticleFromNormal covers only numeric magnitudes
a bare comparative adverb with no expressed standard ('better reflects the fundamentals') — the adverbial comparative needs a second, elliptical event to compare against
positioning an entity on an abstract scale ('the euro is at the level') — LocatedIn is physical containment and there is no eventuality for an event oblique to attach to
notes: The nested seal (outer 'he said' over the inner 'one can say') and the definite plural 'the fundamentals' as a group witness are handled correctly. (Agent sk_reflect_1 sk_level_1) is the right role for a stative transitive with an inanimate subject.
